insights.one_liner: Dutch construction procurement software company of about 124 people, a recognised visa sponsor with a paid, English-language data role in Nijverdal.

culture.text: Builds cloud software that helps contractors and subcontractors manage tenders, procurement and bids in construction.
About 124 people on LinkedIn, founded in 2007; many studied at Saxion, Windesheim, University of Twente, HAN and Hanze.
Staff mostly work in sales, customer success, business development, engineering and IT.

open.text: Recognised IND sponsor through 12Build Sales B.V.
Its one current opening, a mid-level data role in Nijverdal, does not ask for Dutch and shows the salary.
That role drew around 186 applicants on LinkedIn, so expect competition.

growth.text: Says its platform is used by thousands of companies across Europe and holds Europe's largest subcontractor database.
